an10.63:1.1: [sāvatthi] ye keci bhikkhave mayi niṭṭhaṃ gatā, sabbe te diṭṭhisampannā,
an10.63:1.2: tesaṃ diṭṭhisampannānaṃ pañcannaṃ idha niṭṭhā, pañcannaṃ idha vihāya niṭṭhā,
an10.63:1.4: sattakkhattuparamassa kolaṅkolassa ekabījissa sakadāgāmissa, yo ca diṭṭheva dhamme arahā,
an10.63:1.7: antarāparinibbāyissa, upahaccaparinibbāyissa, asaṅkhāraparinibbāyissa, sasaṅkhāraparinibbāyissa, uddhaṃ sotassa akaniṭṭhagāmino.
an10.63:1.9: ye keci bhikkhave mayi niṭṭhaṃ gatā, sabbe te diṭṭhisampannā.
an10.63:1.10: tesaṃ diṭṭhisampannānaṃ imesaṃ pañcannaṃ idha vihāya niṭṭhāti.
